content: CSS package: exports map with '.' -> ./styles.css and subpath patterns './tokens/*'. sideEffects: CSS files must be listed as side-effectful (e.g. sideEffects:['**/*.css']) or bundlers drop imported CSS in prod. For JS component lib: preserve per-component modules (bundle:false or entry per file), sideEffects:false since CSS lives in separate package; single-file bundles defeat sideEffects-based elimination.
